sections.title: Open discrepancies
sections.sql: select supplier,as_of,currency,reference,outcome,review_state from v_attention order by supplier,reference

sections.title: Snapshot reviews
sections.sql: select supplier,as_of,currency,status,matched,exceptions,unresolved from v_runs order by supplier

sections.title: Source totals
sections.sql: select supplier,kind,as_of,currency,lines,total_cents,declared_cents from v_batches order by supplier,kind
